comment: The grit knob runs 0 to 1 while the CV is added in volts, so a single volt covers the whole range and anything above 1V is clamped away. The rise and fall of the envelope follower go from 1000 and 10 at grit 0 to 11000 and 1010 at grit 1 (src/dimit.cpp:44). The module has a red light declared and placed on the panel, PATH10_LIGHT, whose only setBrightnessSmooth call is inside a commented-out block at :52-60, so it is permanently dark. The manual describes the threshold and grit as inputs where the panel has a knob and a jack for grit and only a knob for threshold. Panel order and index order agree.
